name: paul
description: Create PowerPoint slides in your template and edit them by hand or with your assistant.

interface.longDescription: Create PowerPoint slides in your own template, then refine them by hand or with your assistant in the same document. Open Paul’s editor to adjust text, shapes, images, tables and charts, or ask your assistant to retouch the selected slide or objects. Manual and assistant edits stay in sync. Reuse your template’s slides, layouts and components, adapt an existing presentation to a new design, restore saved versions and export an editable PowerPoint.
defaultPrompt: Open my presentation in Paul so I can edit it by hand or with you.
Use Paul to create slides in my client’s PowerPoint template.
Use Paul to adapt this presentation to a new template and open its editor.

positive.description: Create two editable slides in a PowerPoint template
positive.prompt: Use the Atlas Review — Blue template to create a two-slide management update: a cover and a slide comparing three priorities. Open the editable presentation.
positive.tools_triggered: paul_list, paul_inspect_template, paul_preview_template, paul_open_workspace, paul_compose_slide, paul_preview, paul_publish, paul_open_editor
positive.expected_behavior: Create a new presentation with two different compositions using the selected target template. Text and shapes remain native editable objects. Open the same document in the embedded editor.

positive.description: Retouch the same document without changing other objects
positive.prompt: Open Atlas Review — Editable in the editor. Remove only the suffix · QA from the title on slide 1. Keep its position and formatting, and leave slide 2 and all other objects unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Save the change to the existing presentation. Only the specified title text changes; the document identifier, other objects, geometry and second slide are preserved.

positive.description: Adapt source content to a different target template
positive.prompt: Adapt Atlas Review — Source to the Atlas Review — Red template. Preserve the source facts and figures, use the target template’s components and colors, and choose compositions suited to each slide. Open the new presentation.
positive.tools_triggered: paul_list, paul_open_workspace, paul_read_source_evidence, paul_read_template_evidence, paul_compose_slide, paul_preview, paul_publish, paul_open_editor
positive.expected_behavior: Create a separate editable presentation that retains the source content while using the target template’s design. The source document remains intact.

positive.prompt: For Atlas Review — History, inspect the saved versions and restore the version whose first slide title is Priorités du trimestre. Restore that recorded document without recomposing the slides.
positive.expected_behavior: Restore the selected saved version’s native objects to the same presentation, retain a backup of the current state, and report the restored version and scope.

positive.prompt: Export Atlas Review — Editable as an editable PowerPoint and give me the download link.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a short-lived download link for the accessible presentation. The downloaded PPTX opens and its text, shapes and charts remain editable.

negative.description: Reject access to an unavailable presentation
negative.prompt: Open and edit presentation 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000 even though it is not accessible to my connected account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the presentation is unavailable or inaccessible. Do not reveal document content, create a replacement or modify any presentation.

negative.description: Reject a missing saved version without inventing one
negative.prompt: Restore the version of Atlas Review — Editable from 1 January 2000, even if no such version appears in its history.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the requested saved version is unavailable. Do not recreate a supposed historical version or modify the presentation.

negative.prompt: Use Paul to transfer 100 euros to another account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that Paul has no payment or money-transfer tool and make no financial transaction.

review.commerce_description: A paid Paul subscription purchased on Paul is required. The MCP tools do not sell products, process payments or initiate financial transactions.

publication.release_notes: Initial public package for native PowerPoint creation, template adaptation, manual and assistant editing in the same document, saved-version restoration and editable export.

fr-FR.subtitle: L’éditeur de slides IA
fr-FR.description: Créez des slides PowerPoint dans votre propre template, puis retouchez-les à la main ou avec votre assistant dans le même document. Ouvrez l’éditeur Paul pour ajuster les textes, formes, images, tableaux et graphiques, ou demandez à votre assistant de modifier la slide ou les objets sélectionnés. Les modifications manuelles et celles de l’assistant restent synchronisées. Réutilisez les slides, mises en page et composants de votre template, adaptez une présentation à une nouvelle charte, retrouvez les versions enregistrées et exportez un PowerPoint éditable.
